BY MEMBER-SECRETARY, PROPOSAL SCRUTINY COMMITTEE AND
JOINT DIRECTOR OF TOWN PLANNING, PUNE
Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966
NOTIFICATION
No. R. P. Pune/Sect. 20(4)/Mouje Bavdhan Bk., Taluka Mulshi/G. No. 173/JDTP-479/2024.––Whereas,
the Government vide Resolution No. TPS-1815/CR-49/15/UD-13, dated 6th May 2015 and 4th January
2016 has issued directives under Section 154 of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966
(hereinafter referred to as “the said Act”) regarding the procedure to be followed under Section 20 of the
said Act, for making changes in the use of land falling in the areas of sanctioned Regional Plan under
the said Act ;
and whereas, total area admeasuring 5023.75 sq.mtrs. bearing G. No. 173 (P) excluding area included
in HTHS and 500 yard distance from HEMRL of Mouje Bavdhan Bk., Taluka Mulshi, District Pune is
included in Agriculture / No Development Zone as per sanctioned Regional Plan of Pune of which zone
change proposal is submitted (hereinafter referred to as “the said land”) ;
and whereas, Government Resoluation No. TPS-1812/737/12/CR-506/13/Reconstruction No.110/
Section 20(3)/UD-13, dated 7th July 2014 has been published under Section 20(3) of the said Act, for
inviting suggestion and objection, for including the said land into Residential Zone and authorised the
Assistant Director of Town Planning, Pune Branch, Pune (hereinafter referred to as the “said Officer”)
to submit a report after giving hearing to the suggestions / objection so received in response to the notice
under Section 20(3) of the said Act, to be published in Maharashtra Government Gazettee as well as
and whereas, the said Officer had submitted a report stating that all legal procedures stipulated in
the said Act had been completed and no suggestion / objection had been received within the stipulated
period about the said Modification ;
and whereas, after considering the report submitted by the said Officer in its meeting, dated 23rd
October 2023, the Proposal Scrutiny Committee has made a decision to include the said land into
Residential Zone as shown on plan subject to certain conditions ;
and whereas, the said land owners have paid the requisite processing fees, advertisement charges
and Premium in the Government Treasury.

Now therefore, under the powers delegated by the Government, The Joint Director of Town Planning,
Pune Division, Pune hereby sanctions the modification under sub-section 4 of Section 20 of the said
Act and for that purpose directs that in the Schedule of Modifications appended to the Notification, dated
25th November 1997 sanctioning the said Regional Plan, after the last entry, the following new entry
shall be added ;
ENTRY
In the Sanctioned Regional Plan of Pune, the allocation of the land admeasuring about 5023.75
sq.mtrs. bearing G. No. 173 (part) excluding area included in HTHS and 500 yards distance from HEMRL
of Mouje Bavdhan Bk., Taluka Mulshi, District Pune is changed from “Agriculture / No Development Zone”
to “Residential Zone” as shown on the plan, subject to the following conditions.
(1) The terms and conditions laid down in the said Government Resolutions dated 6th May 2015, 4th
January 2016 are binding on the land owner / developer.
(2) In addition to 10 per cent area of open space, additional 15 per cent area for the amenity space,
shall be mandatory to be kept in the layout of the land under zone change.
(3) Land Owner / Developer shall develop internal roads, open space(s) amenity space(s) at his own
cost. It shall be necessary for him to provide compound wall around open space(s) and amenity
space(s).
(4) All necessary basic infrastructure for civic amenities such as potable and Sufficient Water Supply,
Sewerage System, Soild Waste Management, Waste Water Treatment Plant etc. required for the
development of the said land under modification shall be made available by the Land Owner / Developer
at his own cost.
(5) In the amenity space, Development / Construction of amenity shall be made by the Land Owner /
Developer as suggested by the Authority.
(6) Development shall not be permissible on the land having slope equal to or steeper than 1:5 and the
said land shall not be considered for development and also the FSI of the said land shall not be
permissible.
(7) It shall be binding on the Land Owner / Developer to develop approach road of requisite width as per
the Regulations at his own cost.
(8) No Development and construction shall be permissible in the area falling within a distance of 500
yards (457.20 mtrs.) from the boundary of High Enery Material Research Laboratory (HEMRL).
(9) The Terms and Conditions accepted by the applicant vide the affidavit submitted on dated 2nd February
2023 as per Annexure “C” of the said Government Resolution, dated 2nd August 2019 shall be binding
on the applicant.
The Part Plan showing the lands under the sanctioned Modification shall be made available for
inspection to the general public, in the office of Assistant Director of Town Planning, Pune Branch, Pune.
R. M. PAWAR,
Member-Secretary,
Proposal Scrutiny Committee and
Joint Director of Town Planning,
Pune, 13th March 2024. Pune Division, Pune.
---------------------------------

-------------------------------------
Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966
NOTIFICATION
No. R.P.Solapur/Sect.20(4)/Mouje Natepute/Tal.Malshiras/Gat Nos.95 and 97/JDTP-469/2024.––
Whereas, the Government vide Resolution No. TPS-1815/CR-49/15/UD-13, dated 6th May 2015 and
4th January 2016 has issued directives under Section 154 of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning
Act, 1966 (hereinafter referred as “the said Act”) regarding the procedure to be followed under Section
20 of the said Act, for making changes in the use of land falling in the areas of sanctioned Regional Plan
under the said Act ;
whereas, the Government has sanctioned the Regional Plan for Solapur District on 9th February
2015 (hereinafter referred to as “the said Regional Plan”) under the provisions of Maharashtra Regional
and Town Planning Act, 1966 (hereinafter referred to as “the said Act”) and has came into force with
effect from 26th June 2015 ;
and whereas, total area admeasuring 10.35 Ha. bearing Gat Nos. 95 and 97 of Mouje Natepute,
Taluka Malshiras, District Solapur is included in Agriculture / No Development Zone as per sanctioned
Regional Plan of Solapur of which zone change proposal is submitted (hereinafter referred as “the said
Land”) ;
and whereas, a Notice No. R.P. Solapur/Mouje Natepute/Tal. Malshiras/G.Nos. 95 and 97/Section
20(3)/JDTP/1170, dated 25th July 2023 has been published under Section 20(3) of the said Act, for inviting
suggestion and objection, for including the said land into Residential Zone and authorised the Assistant
Director of Town Planning, Soalpur Branch, Solapur (hereinafter referred to as “the said Officer”) to submit
a report after giving hearing to the suggestions / objections so received in response to the Notice under
Section 20(3) of the said Act, to be published in Maharashtra Government Gazette as well as local News
Papers ;
and whereas, the said Officer had submitted a report stating that, all legal procedures stipulated in
the said Act had been completed and no suggestion / objection had been received within the stipulated
period about the said Modification ;
and whereas, after considering the report submitted by the said Officer in its meeting, dated
3rd January 2024, the Proposal Scrutiny Committee has made a decision to include the said land into
Residential Zone as shown on plan subject to certain conditions ;

and whereas, the said land owners have paid the requisite processing fees, advertisement charges
and Premium in the Government Treasury.
Now therefore, under the powers delegated by the Government the Joint Director of Town Planning,
Pune Division, Pune hereby sanctions the modification under sub-section 4 of Section 20 of the said Act
and for that purpose directs that in the Schedule of Modifications appended to the Notification dated 9th
February 2015 sanctioning the said Regional Plan, after the last entry, the following new entry shall be
added ;
ENTRY
In the Sanctioned Regional Plan of Solapur, the allocation of the land admeasuring about 10.35
Hactare of Mauje Natepute, Taluka Malshiras, District Solapur, Gat Nos. 95 and 97 is changed from
“Agriculture/No Development Zone” to “Residential Zone” as shown on the plan, subject to the following
conditions.
(1) The Terms and Conditions laid down in the said Government Resolutions, dated 6th May 2015,
4th January 2016 are binding on the land owner/developer.
(2) The Terms and Conditions mentioned in Collector, Solapur, Senior Geologist, Ground Water Surveys
and Development Agency, Pune, Chief Engineer, Public Works Regional Division, Pune, Chief Engineer,
Irrigation Regional Division, Pune, Chief Engineer, Maharashtra Jivan Pradhikaran, Regional Division,
Pune, Assistant Director of Town Planning, Solapur Branch, Solapur letter, dated 22nd May 2023,
dated 21st September 2022, dated 9th May 2023, dated 9th May 2023, dated 10th May 2023 and
dated 17th May 2023 respectively shall remain binding on the land holder / developer.
(3) It shall be mandatory to provide 10 per cent Open Space along with 10 per cent Amenity Space as
per Unified Development Control and Promotion Regulations (UDCPR) along with additional land of
area admeasuring 0.50 Ha. for the development of Primary School and Play Ground.
(4) The amalgamation of Gat Nos. 95 and 97 is not permissible due to existing road passing through
said Gat Nos. Also it is mandatory to show existing road on plan while granting building permission.
If the existing road is classified road then it is mandatory to propose road widening accordingly and
if not, then width of road should be proposed as per proposed length.
(5) The Terms and Conditions accepted by the applicant vide the affidavit submitted on dated 26th October
2020 as per Annexure “C” of the said Government Resolution, dated 10th August 2022 shall be binding
on the applicant.
The Part Plan showing the lands under the sanctioned modification shall be made available for
inspection to the general public, in the office of Assistant Director of Town Planning, Solapur Branch,
Solapur.
R. M. PAWAR,
Member-Secretary,
Proposal Scrutiny Committee and
Joint Director of Town Planning,
Pune, 13th March 2024. Pune Division, Pune.

Notification
No. Desk IV/Gavthan/RR-200/Van/C.R./16/2024.---- In exercise of the powers of the State Government
under the provision to sub-section (1) of Section 4 of the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code, 1966 ( Mah.
XLI of 1966) delegated to me by Government Notification, Revenue and Forest Department No. TLC-1076/
63923/M-6, dated 1st July 1976 and after previous publication as required by sub-section (4) of the said
Section 4, I, Sanjay Shinde, the Additional Collector of Kolhapur District, constitute a new village from
village Danwad in Shirol Taluka of Kolhapur District with effect from the 15th March 2024 to be a village
called Nave Danwad in the taluka of the said district, having the limits specified in the schedule hereto
appended.
Schedule
Gat Nos. included in new village Nave Danwad, Taluka Shirol.
Gat Nos.---- 801 to 819, 820/1, 820/2, 821 to 834, 835/A, 835/B, 836 to 889, 890/1, 890/2, 891/A, 891/B,
891/K, 892/A, 892/B, 893 to 945, 946/1, 946/2, 947 to 949, 1037 to 1123, 1124/1/2 to 1124/1/177, 1124/A,
1124/B, 1125 to 1169, 1170/A, 1170/B, 1171/A, 1171/B, 1172/A, 1172/B, 1173 to 1176, 1177/1, 1177/2, 1178
to 1259, 1260/A, 1260/B, 1261 to 1316, 1317/A, 1317/B, 1318/A, 1318/B, 1319 to 1338.
Note.---- 1. Residents of the new village shall have the rights over the assigned lands of residuary village
for the purpose of grazing forest, cremation and threshing.
2. The right of way on the existing roads is also available to both the villagers.
SANJAY SHINDE,

BY CHIEF OFFICER
DEHU NAGARPANCHAYAT, DEHU
Declaration of Intention to prepare Development Plan of Dehu Nagarpanchayat as per Section 23 (1) read
with Section 21 (2) of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966.
Notice
No. Dehu N.P./T. P. /05/1715/2024.----Government of Maharashtra in Urban Development Department,
vide it's Notification No. MUP-2017/C.R.-14/UD-18, dated 8th December 2020 constituted Dehu
Nagarpanchayat. It is necessary to prepare the Development Plan for the area of Nagarpanchayat as per
Section 21 (2) of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 for Planned Development of the said
area ;
Hence, the Dehu Nagarpanchayat by its resolution No. 1, dated 8th January 2024 has given consent
to declare its intention to prepare Development Plan, as per provision of Section 23 (1) read with Section
21 (2) of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966. Accordingly, this Notice is being Published ;
The plan showing boundary of the area included in Development Plan of Dehu Nagarpanchayat is
kept open for inspection by the public on all office working days, during office hours at the office of the Dehu
Nagarpanchayat, as required under Section 23 (2) of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act,
1966 ;
Any Suggestion/Objection of the public in this regard, may be forwarded in writing to the Chief Officer,
Dehu Nagarpanchayat within a period of 60 (Sixty) days from the date of publication of this Notice in
Maharashtra Government Gazette. The suggestion/objection shall be duly considered while preparing the
Development Plan.
NIVEDITA GHARGE,
Chief Officer,
Dehu Nagarpanchayat, Dehu.
Dehu, 14th March 2024.

read with Section 21 (2) of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966.
Notice
No. KNP/1046/2023-24 .----Government of Maharashtra in Urban Development Department, vide it's
Notification No. MUP-2015/P.K.-91/UD-19, dated 24th May 2016 constituted Khandala Nagarpanchayat.
It's necessary to prepare the Development Plan for the area of Khandala Nagarpanchayat as per Section
21 (2) of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 for planned Development of the said area.
Hence, the Khandala Nagarpanchayat by it's resolution No. 1, dated 15th March 2024 has given
consent to declare its intention to prepare Development Plan, as per provision of Section 23 (1) read with
Section 21 (2) of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966. Accordingly, this Notice is being
published.
The plan showing boundary of the area included in Development Plan of Khandala Nagarpanchayat is
kept open for inspection by the public on office working days, during office hours at the office of the Khandala
Nagarpanchayat, as required under Section 23 (2) of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act,
1966 ;
Any suggestion/objection of the public in this regard, may be forwarded in writing to the Chief Officer,
Khandala Nagarpanchayat within a period of 60 (Sixty) days from the date of publication of this Notice in
Maharashtra Government Gazette. The Suggestion/Objection shall be dully considered while preparing
the Development Plan.
CHETAN KONDE,
Chief Officer,
Khandala Nagarpanchayat,
Khandala.

KADEGAON NAGARPANCHAYAT, KADEGAON
Publication of Draft Development Plan of Kadegaon under Section 26 (1) of Maharashtra Regional &
Town Planning Act. 1966.
Notice
No. Kadegaon N.P./2124/2023-24.–– Whereas, the Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat (hereinafter referred
to as “the said Planning Authority”) vide Resolution No. 9, dated 25th January 2023 had declared its
intention to prepare a Draft Development Plan of Kadegaon (hereinafter referred to as “the said Draft
Development Plan”) for the area under its jurisdiction (hereinafter referred to as “the said area”) as per
the provision of Section 23(1) read with Section 21(2) of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act,
1966 (hereinafter referred to as “the said Act”)) and Notice to that effect is published in Maharashtra
Government Gazette, Part-1 - Pune Division Supplement, February 16 to 22, 2023.
and whereas, as per the provision in Section 24 of the said Act, the Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat
vide Order No. 638/2023, dated 19th May 2023 has appointed Assistant Director Town Planning, Sangli
Branch, Sangli as Town Planning Officer to prepare the said Draft Development Plan for the said area ;
and whereas, the Town Planning Officer and Assistant Director, Town Planning, Sangli Branch,
Sangli after having prepared Existing Land Use Map as per Section 25 of the said Act, has prepared the
said Draft Development Plan of the said area and has handed it over to the said Planning Authority on
6th March 2024 for publication under Section 26(1) of the said Act ;
and whereas, the said Planning Authority has passed Resolution No. 3, dated 14th March 2024 to
publish the said Draft Development Plan under Section 26(1) of the said Act, for inviting suggestions /
objections from the public ;
Therefore, Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat hereby publishes the said Draft Development Plan along with
the Report under Section 26(1) of the said Act for inviting suggestions / objections from the public. The
copy of the said Draft Development Plan and Report thereof are kept open for inspection of the public
at the following offices on all working days during office hours.
(1) The Chief Officer, Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat.
(2) Assistant Director, Town Planning, Sangli Branch, Sangli.
The suggestions / objections if any, in writing from the public in this regard with reasons, shall be
submitted to the Chief Officer, Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat within the period of 30 days from the date of
publication of the Notice in Maharashtra Government Gazette. Suggestions / objections received by the
Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat within the period of the 30 days from the date of publication of this Notice in
Maharashtra Government Gazette shall only be considered.
The copies of the said Draft Development Plan and particulars shall be available to the public at
reasonable price in the office of the Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat.
DR. PAVAN MHETRE,
Chief Officer,
Kadegaon Nagarpanchayat,
Kedgaon, District Sangli.
Kedgaon, 15th March 2024.

BY CHIEF OFFICER
LONAND NAGARPANCHAYAT, LONAND
Publication of list of Modifications / Changes in Draft Development Plan of Lonand Nagarpachayat under
Section 28(4) of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966.
Notice
No. Lonand N.P./2269/2024.–– Whereas, Lonand Nagarpanchayat being Planning Authority has
published the Draft Development Plan of Lonand Nagarpanchayat under Section 26(1) of the Maharashtra
Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 vide Notice dated 6th April 2023 for inviting suggestions / objections
from public. The said Notice is published in Maharashtra Government Gazzette, Part-1 -- Pune Division
Supplement, dated 6th April 2023.
and whereas, after considering the suggestions / objections to the said plan received within stipulated
period, the Planning Committee constituted under Section 28(4) of the said Act, has submitted its report
within the extended time period as per Outword No.1071/2023, dated 30th August 2023 to the said Planning
Authority on 27th September 2023.
and whereas, the said Planning Authority after considering the report submitted by Planning
Committee, suggested changes in it and passed Resolution No. 77, dated 26th October 2023 to make
Modifications to the said Plan and to submit the said Plan for Sanction to the Government under Section
30 of the said Act ;
and whereas, it is necessary to publish the said modifications made in the said Plan for inspection
of the public as per Section 28(4) of the said Act ;
Now, therefore, the list of modifications made under Section 28(4) of the Act, by the said Planning
Authority is hereby published as Appendix-A as per the provisions of said Act for information of the public.
The said Draft Development Plan showing the modifications is kept open for the inspection of the public
in the following offices, on all working days, during office hours for a period of 30 days and is also available
on website.
(1) The Chief Officer, Lonand Nagarpanchayat, Satara.
(2) Assistant Director, Town Planning, Satara Branch, Satara.
